second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 12 + Average 4 + Difficulty 2 = 18), pdf 44; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-18 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-3, II 4-6, III 7-10, IV 11-13, V 14-18); answer side keys 1-18 in order (q15's key prints its own inner points '2.' and '3.'). BLUE PRINT 12/4/2 = 18 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 18.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 44 (heading 'Unit -11', LO 12, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 45 (box, q4-13) 46 (q14-18). A side 'Key Answers Unit 11 :- Importance opf Teeth' pdf 112 (below the last Unit-10 keys; keys 1-18). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides).

Sections: s1 I match q1-3 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s2 II fill-from-box q4-6 (the box '( Permanent tooth, 32, deciduous tooth )' printed once above q4, kept on each stem's second line); s3 III T/F q7-10; s4 IV q11-13 (printed blank -> fill; text = section instruction + item); s5 V q14-18 (one sentence/list -> vsa; q15 three printed points -> sa, 3 steps).
MARKS (R-E9, control rev 3): every header's N equals its printed count -> s1 1, s2 1, s3 1, s4 1, s5 2 (section_header).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 18 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 12, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

KEYS: match keys 2 and 3 both print 'To eat food' (their Kannada lines read 'to tear' / 'to grind') -> 'match key value not among column-B items'. q11 coconut -> 'Canine' (its Kannada line names the molar) -> 'printed key contradicts fact' (review-blocking). Fill keys kept verbatim although they do not use the box words: q4 'milk' (box 'deciduous tooth'), q5 'eternal' (box 'Permanent tooth'). q15 key points 'Fang', 'Jaws' (renderings of canine / molar) kept verbatim; its first point printed '15.. Incisors'.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-11-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
